title.en: AI agents run without permission prompts
title.ko: AI 에이전트가 허락 없이 실행되도록 설정됨

items.check: Look at agent settings and shell aliases/scripts for --dangerously-skip-permissions, bypassPermissions, --yolo, approval_policy=never with full access, or sandbox disabled. Only explicit bypasses count. Vendor-reviewed modes are the user's choice and not a finding: Claude Code auto mode (a classifier reviews each action), Codex approvals with the sandbox on.

fix.en: Remove the bypass flag/mode. Allow specific safe tools instead of everything.
fix.ko: 우회 플래그나 모드를 빼고, 필요한 도구만 골라서 허용하세요.

title.en: Agents can read untrusted content and act without review
title.ko: 에이전트가 외부 글을 읽고 확인 없이 행동할 수 있음

items.check: Report only when an agent can BOTH read untrusted content (web pages, mail, issues, PR comments) AND run shell commands or write files without approval. If agent-skip-permissions already reports the same setting, add this risk to that finding instead of a separate one. Vendor-reviewed modes are the user's choice and not a finding: Claude Code auto mode (a classifier reviews each action), Codex approvals with the sandbox on.

fix.en: Keep web reading and shell execution in separate, approval-gated steps.
fix.ko: 웹 읽기와 명령 실행을 나누고, 실행 전에는 승인을 받게 하세요.

title.en: Agent hooks run commands that reach the network
title.ko: 에이전트 훅이 네트워크로 나가는 명령을 실행함

items.check: Agent hooks (Claude Code hooks, Codex notify and similar) that download and run code (curl ... | sh, iwr ... | iex), send files or environment variables to a host, or run scripts the user did not write. A hook that only posts a notification to a service the user already uses is fine.

fix.en: Read every hook command. Delete hooks that download code or that you did not write yourself.
fix.ko: 훅 명령을 하나씩 읽고, 코드를 내려받아 실행하거나 직접 만들지 않은 훅은 지우세요.

title.en: MCP servers from sources you cannot verify
title.ko: 출처를 확인할 수 없는 MCP 서버

items.check: MCP servers whose package or URL is not from the tool's own vendor or a well-known publisher, look-alike package names, or servers not used recently. A missing version pin alone belongs to mcp-unpinned, not here.

fix.en: Remove servers you cannot trace to their publisher and the ones you no longer use.
fix.ko: 제공처를 확인할 수 없는 서버와 안 쓰는 서버는 지우세요.

title.en: MCP servers run without a pinned version
title.ko: 버전을 고정하지 않고 실행하는 MCP 서버

items.check: MCP server definitions that run npx -y pkg, uvx pkg, @latest or pip installs without an exact version, so a new release runs without review.

fix.en: Pin an exact version (pkg@1.2.3, pkg==1.2.3) and update on purpose.
fix.ko: 정확한 버전(pkg@1.2.3, pkg==1.2.3)으로 고정하고, 업데이트는 확인하고 직접 하세요.

title.en: API keys written in plain text inside agent/MCP config
title.ko: 에이전트·MCP 설정 파일에 API 키가 평문으로 적혀 있음

items.check: Redacted markers ([REDACTED:...]) inside env/headers of MCP or agent configs.

fix.en: Move keys to the OS keychain or environment, and rotate any key that was ever committed or shared.
fix.ko: 키는 OS 키체인이나 환경변수로 옮기고, 공유된 적 있는 키는 새로 발급하세요.

title.en: Git or package registry tokens stored in plain files
title.ko: Git·패키지 저장소 토큰이 평문 파일에 있음

items.check: ~/.git-credentials or credential.helper=store; auth tokens in ~/.npmrc, ~/.pypirc, ~/.netrc or ~/.docker/config.json. Any agent or install script can read these files, and stolen registry tokens are how package worms spread.

fix.en: Use the OS credential manager for git, short-lived granular tokens for registries, and delete tokens you no longer use.
fix.ko: Git은 OS 자격 증명 관리자를 쓰고, 저장소 토큰은 기간·권한이 제한된 것으로 바꾸고, 안 쓰는 토큰은 지우세요.

title.en: Shell history contains keys or tokens

items.check: bash, zsh, fish or PowerShell history containing values that match key or token patterns (only the file name is reported).

fix.en: Delete those lines and rotate the key. Set keys in environment variables or a keychain instead of typing them into commands.
fix.ko: 그 줄을 지우고 키를 새로 발급하세요. 키는 명령에 직접 치지 말고 환경변수나 키체인에 넣으세요.

title.en: AI or dev services reachable from the network
title.ko: AI·개발 서비스가 외부에서 접속 가능하게 열려 있음

items.check: Listening TCP sockets bound to 0.0.0.0 or [::] by AI and developer services: model servers (Ollama 11434, LM Studio), MCP servers, notebooks (Jupyter 8888), dev servers and databases. System services are out of scope.

fix.en: Bind to 127.0.0.1, or block the port in the firewall.

title.ko: 설치된 도구가 오늘 나온 보안 경고에 해당함

items.check: Compare installed AI CLIs, global npm/pip packages and their versions with advisories and incident reports from the last few days.

fix.en: Update or remove the affected package, then rotate tokens it could read.
fix.ko: 해당 패키지를 업데이트·삭제하고, 그 패키지가 읽을 수 있던 토큰은 새로 발급하세요.

note: Core checks every AI-agent user should have. They cannot be turned off; add more from extras.json or your own in ~/.shieldbug/checklist/local.json.
